novelty_basis: Not stated in the sources read: B. Le Floch's notes 'Spectra of equational laws' (ETP, 2025) list 1313 as 'unknown spectrum starting with 1,5,7'; the ETP paper (arXiv:2512.07087) does not discuss 1313 in the parts read. ETP members may hold unpublished searches, so novelty is relative to these sources.
proof_check: computer-assisted - the CNFs of the case split of proofs/paper/C05.md Lemma 8 (written proof), with the implied division clauses of Lemma 9 (written) and Latin rows (Lean: law1313_left_bijective) and Latin columns (Lean: law1313_right_bijective), are all UNSAT, each refuted by a DRAT proof from CaDiCaL 1.5.3 that drat-trim verified (45 + 97 CNFs; EXP-C05-08); the controls at n = 5, 6, 7 agree with EXP-C05-03; awaiting independent review (Skeptic, batch 1.1)
statement: No magma of order 8 or 10 satisfies x = y(((yx)x)y) (ETP equation 1313). With CLM-C05-07, the ETP notes and EXP-C05-03, the orders n <= 10 of finite models of 1313 are exactly 1, 5, 7 and 9.
title: Law 1313, x = y(((yx)x)y), has no model of order 8 or 10 (DRAT-certified); its orders up to 10 are exactly 1, 5, 7, 9
